title: permissionProfileLocation
responsibility: Links a permission profile in the shown branch and revision.

inputs.name: permissionProfileLocation.route
inputs.description: The Explorer location the link is built from; only its branch and commit are read, and a null branch or commit is copied as null. Its other fields, such as helper, section and tab, are not carried over.

inputs.name: permissionProfileLocation.entity
inputs.description: The permission profile ID to put in the result's entity field; the function does not check it. Omitted or an empty string leaves the result without an entity field.

outputs.name: permissionProfileLocation
outputs.description: The route to the Pages permissions screen: category 'pages' and screen 'permissions', with the branch and commit of the input route. It has an entity field only when the entity input is a non-empty string, and that field holds the string unchanged.

errors.name: Input access failure
errors.description: An error raised while reading route.branch or route.commit, such as by a getter, propagates unchanged to the caller.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when route is null or undefined, because reading branch and commit from it fails.
